title: Dry-end hydraulic relevance and representation bound
source_authority: Earlier O05 dry-end Newton-conditioning investigation, reconciled into current AHL research

scientific_observation.interpretation: In the extremely dry O05 regime, C falls to about 1e-10..1e-13 and below about 1e-13 the storage response is practically negligible for the investigated Newton solve. Further representational refinement there should not be assumed hydrologically useful.

current_AHL_implication.rule: Adaptive refinement must have an explicit dry-end relevance stop. It must not spend support points solely to resolve constitutive variation below an already-qualified negligible-storage regime.
do_not_conflate: the scientific dry-end relevance scale around C ~ 1e-13
current_AHL_implication.implementation_direction: Derive a material-specific dry-end representation boundary from authoritative hydraulics and the frozen numerical relevance policy, then use an exact/regularized tail contract rather than continued adaptive knot refinement.

current_domain_check.finding: The current nominal AHL09 domain extends materially beyond the earlier O05 dry-end relevance scale and should therefore be tightened or explicitly tailed before broader qualification.
